svg.title: Sophie & Alex — Save the Date
svg.desc: Hand-drawn watercolor save-the-date: city hall with clock tower, double-happiness lanterns, and Sophie and Alex holding hands. Structured for animation: - Every element lives in a named group (#title, #city-hall, #sophie, #alex, ...) - Lettering (#title/#names/#footer) is traced 1:1 from the original handwriting as filled outline paths, one path per letter, ordered left-to-right for stagger animation. For a write-on effect, use the monoline letters in defs as animated mask strokes over each glyph. - Repeated motifs (letters, lantern, corner flourish, pride flag, dormer, arch, blossom, sparkle) are defs referenced with use. - Washes use gradients + the #wc pigment-mottle filter for continuous watercolor shading; #soft blurs shading blobs. - #background can be hidden for a transparent version.
